class.name: DialogueBox
class.brief_description: A box that shows one line of dialogue with the choices under it.
class.description: The Dialogue message step of a graph script puts one of these on the stage. It shows who speaks, the line, and one button for each choice. With no choices it shows one Continue button. To use your own box, make a prefab whose root has a [method show_message] method and a [signal finished] signal. Wire the prefab to the step's [code]prefab[/code] input, or set the [code]graph_script/dialogue/prefab[/code] project setting to use it for every message. This class is the box the step makes when neither is set.

method.name: choose
method.description: Emits [signal finished] with [param index]. Choices count from zero. Pass [code]-1[/code] for Continue. The step that put the box on the stage removes it.

method.name: get_choices
method.description: Returns the text of each choice on show, in the order they appear.

method.name: get_speaker
method.description: Returns who speaks the line on show.

method.name: show_message
method.description: Shows [param text] said by [param speaker], with one button for each entry of [param choices]. A box that shows a message again replaces the buttons it had.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted when a button is pressed. [param index] is the number of the choice, counted from zero, or [code]-1[/code] for Continue.
